title: Sonic Colors
shortDescription: Sonic Colors helps define a Wii platformer path in GameAtlas through original editorial framing and a direct Wikidata record.
highlights: Maps a direct-reference platformer entry into the Wii catalog.
Links the catalog entry to a source record without presenting a rating.
